citations.quote: Im Bad wächst an der Decke grau-grüner Schimmel, und im Gang riecht es muffig.
Ausserdem bleiben zwei von vier Heizkörpern kalt, auch wenn ich sie ganz aufdrehe.
Wahrscheinlich hängt das mit den kalten Heizkörpern zusammen, aber wer weiss das schon; ohne dass ein Fachmann das untersucht, wird sich die Verwaltung nie bewegen.
Die Nummer der Hinterlegungsstelle in St. Gallen habe ich mir schon notiert, und den nächsten Mietzins habe ich vorerst nicht überwiesen.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The original notice is needed to establish what defects were reported and when.
Needed to establish whether and when the landlord received the defect report.
Needed to document the visible defect, location and observation date.
The reported ventilation explanation needs to be checked against the original response and any proposed work or access arrangements.
Mould is reported; dated moisture and temperature observations are relevant.
Heating faults are reported; request any inspection and service findings.
Health effects are not mentioned and are presumed absent for planning; revisit if symptoms are reported.
A specialist investigation is reported as needed; the cause remains open. Request any existing report or arrange an inspection.
A deposit is being considered; the communicated deadline and recipient must be checked. Withholding rent is not itself a deposit: obtain urgent advice before further non-payment.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: When did the mould and heating problems begin, and have you experienced any symptoms or immediate safety concerns?
When and how did you notify the landlord, and did you set a written repair deadline?
Have any inspections, repair proposals or access arrangements taken place?
When was the unpaid rent due, and has any rent actually been deposited with an official deposit authority?
